node.text: Hlurb. It's great being human. I love to breathe... through three little holes instead of my whole skin.~ Oh, yes. As a human. Uggghhhhh. I can know true loneliness.~ I, a human... am easily biased by my complicated emotions.~ Glllrbbbb. I am not tired. I do not need to "lie down" or otherwise collapse. Hrrgh. Humans are well known persistence hunters.~ As a human, grlk. I love ... violence.~ Humans are mammals. They ... bleg ... we. Produce different discharge depending on body region.~ Human... genitalia is. Disgusting, factually. I read it in an Eater text.~ Did you know, that human fingers. Glp. May look dexterous, but they contain 'bones' that severely limit movement.
